summary: ansible-core 2.15 fixed handlers from dynamically included roles so the last-defined handler of a given name is the one run, which changes behaviour when the same role is included multiple times with different vars and conditions.
questions: My role handler runs only on one host after upgrading to 2.15, why?
Which handler runs when two include_role calls define the same handler name?
Does when on a block around include_role apply to its handlers?

answer_card.title: Duplicate handler names with include_role
answer_card.answer_md: If several handlers share a name, the **last one added to the play** runs. Since 2.15 this also applies to handlers from `include_role`. Including the same role twice with different vars creates distinct roles, and a `when` on a wrapping `block` also applies to the included handlers. So the second include's handler (with its `when`) wins. Give handlers unique names or use `listen` if you relied on the old behaviour.
